speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You have presented with gait and limb ataxia; to begin our evaluation, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they been progressive or sudden in onset?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms of looking drunk and feeling clumsy suggest ataxia; you mentioned the right side is particularly affected, but did these symptoms start suddenly or gradually worsen over time? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain.
